value.rationale: An exact complete two-parameter classification of a geometrically canonical unit-width, nonproduct simplex bundle newly motivated by the full few-facet smooth-polytope classification and recent counterexamples for smooth Cayley sums. The uniform real-rootedness theorem implies log-concavity and unimodality of the numerator coefficients and is not implied by Ehrhart polynomial coefficient positivity; the degree-drop and discriminant behavior are exact, and nonproduct unequal-layer cases lie outside standard product-preservation hypotheses. This is a natural infinite family with the precise invariant motivated by current root-location research, not an arbitrary fixed example or an unproved extrapolation.
